title: Replit Alternatives: 7 Honest Options for 2026 (Tested with Real Screenshots)
summary: Tested every serious Replit alternative for 2026. Ranked by price ceiling, lock-in, full-stack depth, and onboarding. Real competitor screenshots and April 2026 pricing.
body_markdown: Replit Agent 4 is strong — genuinely competitive with Blink and Bolt on code quality for mainstream JavaScript/Python projects. Where Replit falls behind is breadth of model choice (Blink offers 200+ models vs Replit narrower set) and portability (Replit Agent tends to generate Replit-specific patterns). For raw code quality on a first build, the agents are roughly tied. The platform around the agent is where the real differences show up.
